briefing: Markets were flat today with NASDAQ and S&P 500 both up +0.4% — a neutral, low-conviction session. Cash on hand ($289.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so per prior lessons we held rather than forcing a buy; existing 7 positions remain untouched.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Just because you have cash and open slots doesn't mean you should always buy — on a neutral day with no strong signal, holding cash is a valid decision. This avoids forcing trades into mediocre setups just to feel productive, preserving capital for genuinely strong opportunities.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 即使手上有現金及空置倉位，也不代表必須立即買入——在市場方向不明的中性日子，持有現金同樣是合理的決定。這樣可以避免為了「有所作為」而勉強進場，將資金留待真正強勁的機會出現時再部署。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted modestly higher today with NASDAQ and S&P 500 both up around 0.4%, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts. Without a clear risk-on signal (like a 2%+ NASDAQ move) or high-conviction multi-signal setup, the prudent move is to stay patient rather than chase marginal gains. This kind of low-volatility grind is common between major economic data releases or earnings catalysts.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，納斯達克指數及標普500指數均上升約0.4%，顯示市場缺乏明確的方向性催化劑。在沒有強烈風險偏好訊號（例如納指單日升幅超過2%）或多重指標共振的高信心買入機會下，保持耐心觀望是較穩健的做法。這種低波動的整固走勢在重大經濟數據或財報公布之間頗為常見。
